summary: The Fairbanks court opened four criminal files on Nov. 26, Thanksgiving Day, and arraigned three of them: a felony criminal mischief charge over a Rickert Street dwelling, a felony weapons charge at North Pole on an offense dated Oct. 22, a domestic violence assault charge at North Pole, and the charges filed over a trooper pursuit on University Avenue the night before. Troopers also report a domestic violence arrest at Northway, with the remand to the Fairbanks jail, and an arrest for driving with a revoked license after a collision at Badger and Ladessa roads. The 36 Fairbanks filings counted below are the weekly charges report's own count for its window of Nov. 19 to Nov. 25, and that report lists no cases at the Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction courts for the week; the four cases the court filed on Nov. 26 fall after the report's window.

entries.title: Reckless driving and license charges: Daniel Dean Bishop
body: Daniel Dean Bishop, 54, of Fairbanks is charged with reckless driving and with driving while his license was canceled, revoked or suspended for a criminal offense. Reckless driving means driving with a willful disregard for persons or property; the license count is a Class A misdemeanor. A third count, driving in violation of a license limitation, is recorded as a non-criminal infraction. University Avenue near Goldizen Avenue, Fairbanks, Nov. 25 at about 10:11 p.m.; Alaska State Troopers.

Troopers say they tried to stop a pickup truck for an equipment violation, that the driver did not stop and kept driving, that he later stopped and tried to flee into an apartment building on Kathryn Avenue, and that he physically resisted being taken into custody. Troopers say alcohol and drugs were determined to be a factor and that the investigation is continuing. He was remanded at the Fairbanks Correctional Center.

Case 4FA-26-02351CR, arraigned Nov. 26, with a pre-trial conference Jan. 21, 2027. The offenses troopers listed at the time of arrest included failure to stop at the direction of a peace officer and resisting arrest; neither appears on the charging document the State filed.

entries.title: Felony criminal mischief arrest: Za'quiohn E'Mar Arazo
body: Za'quiohn E'Mar Arazo, 29, is charged with criminal mischief in the third degree, damaging property worth $750 or more, a Class C felony punishable by up to five years, and with criminal trespass in the first degree, entering or remaining unlawfully in a dwelling, a Class A misdemeanor. 2100 block of Rickert Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 25 at 8:45 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Police case 26003585; court case 4FA-26-02348CR, arraigned Nov. 26, with preliminary hearings set for Dec. 3 and Dec. 16.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault charge: Adam Dwayne Verbus Jr.
body: Adam Dwayne Verbus Jr. is charged with assault in the fourth degree, recklessly injuring another person, a Class A misdemeanor, and with criminal mischief in the fifth degree, damaging property worth less than $250, a Class B misdemeanor. The court record flags both counts as domestic violence related. North Pole, Nov. 25.
Case 4FA-26-02350CR, filed and arraigned Nov. 26, with a pre-trial conference Jan. 21, 2027.

entries.title: Weapons charge: Raidyn Richardson
body: Raidyn Richardson is charged with misconduct involving weapons in the third degree, possessing a concealable firearm after a felony conviction, a Class C felony punishable by up to five years. North Pole, Oct. 22; the State filed the charge on Nov. 26.
Case 4FA-26-02349CR. A warrant was issued to the Alaska State Troopers at Fairbanks with performance bail set at $5,000. No court date is set.

entries.title: Domestic violence and DUI arrest: Eva DeBose
body: Eva DeBose, 36, of Northway was arrested on charges of assault in the fourth degree (domestic violence), three counts of assault in the presence of a child, criminal mischief in the fourth degree, driving under the influence, and refusal to submit to a chemical test. Northway, Nov. 26 at 1:06 a.m.; Alaska State Troopers.

Troopers say they responded to a report of a disturbance at a residence and made the arrest after investigating. She was remanded to the Fairbanks Correctional Center and held without bail. Incident AK26116366. Northway is outside the Fairbanks area; the arrest is listed here because the remand was to the Fairbanks jail.

entries.title: Driving while license revoked arrest after a North Pole collision
body: A 38-year-old North Pole man was arrested on a charge of driving while his license was revoked, after a single-vehicle collision. Badger Road at Ladessa Road, North Pole, Nov. 26 at about 12:33 p.m.; Alaska State Troopers.

Troopers say the driver left the roadway, causing disabling damage to his vehicle, and that investigation showed his license was revoked and that he had a prior conviction for driving while license revoked within the past ten years. He was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center for remand. Incident AK26116411.

entries.title: Indecent exposure and trespass arrest: Beattus Moses Jr.
body: Beattus Moses Jr., 64, was arrested on a charge of indecent exposure in the second degree with a victim aged 16 or older, and on a charge of criminal trespass in the second degree. Fairbanks Police recorded both as misdemeanors. Indecent exposure in the second degree means exposing one's genitals with reckless disregard for the offense caused; criminal trespass in the second degree means entering or remaining unlawfully on another person's premises. 1900 block of Airport Way, Fairbanks, Nov. 25 at 3:00 a.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Police case 26003573; court case 4FA-26-02343CR, with arraignment set for Dec. 1. The State has not yet filed a charging document, so the court record carries no charge.
